title: Performance retest and validation
description: Re-run pipeline, compare to baseline, validate Power BI query performance, document optimized results in performance_optimized.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline retest run 3 times, matching the methodology used for the task-012_1 baseline.
Activity-level durations recorded and compared against the baseline, bronze/silver/gold broken out.
Power BI query response times recorded for representative report pages.
A before/after comparison table is committed to .claude/support/documents/performance_optimized.md, stating the measured deltas whatever they are — including null or negative results.
Any optimization that measurably made things worse is called out explicitly rather than omitted.
notes: Erik runs in Fabric; Claude can prepare the comparison template.
If <30% improvement, document findings and adjust strategy before closing.

RETEST COMPLETE 2026-08-03. Three comparable runs at p_full_load=false (20:15:07, 21:02:08 run 1ee5f0d4, 21:25:33 run 9451efda), warm cache, all defaults untouched, all 10 activities Succeeded in every run, durations from the Monitoring detail pane. HEADLINE: silver-to-gold — the optimization target and 52% of runtime — is a NULL RESULT at 608s avg vs a 573s baseline (+6%, under the pre-registered 15% noise floor; retest 578-638 overlaps baseline 540-638 almost entirely). Nothing measurably improved. ONE CONFIRMED REGRESSION: data_quality_checks 242s avg vs 169s (+43%), and all four post-optimization observations (292/217/217 plus the 14:08 preliminary at 231) exceed the baseline maximum of 206s with no range overlap — the only finding besides functional total that clears a non-overlap test. Causation NOT established and deliberately not asserted: task-012_3 never modified the DQ notebook; the leading hypothesis is that the three quality-observability tables accumulate rows every run, so the checks' scan grows with history. Falsification is cheap (correlate row counts with runtime) and is the single actionable follow-up. Functional total 1170s vs 993s (+18%), all three runs above the baseline max — but baseline runs 1-2 were gap-derived, so this is weaker evidence than the DQ finding and is reported with that caveat. Run 2's Bronze Copy spike (four activities all ~100s vs 19-72s) did NOT reproduce in Run 3 (26-67s) — transient contention, recorded and dismissed, not a regression. task-012_4's lever is confirmed absent on the platform (CREATE INDEX rejected, UPDATE STATISTICS a no-op), so task-012_3 was the only lever in play and the null result is a real null. Full write-up: .claude/support/documents/performance_optimized.md (status FINAL).
